lineEndings.Either: CRLF or LF independently per record, including mixed records
lineEndings.quoted: preserve CR and LF bytes verbatim

profile.encoding: valid UTF-8 Text; byte preserving, no BOM stripping or whitespace trimming
profile.header: ordinary data; never inferred or removed
profile.controls: reject ASCII 0..31 and 127 except CR/LF inside quoted fields
profile.claim: explicit UTF-8 profile; not unqualified strict RFC 4180 conformance

invariants: negative limits and negative expectedColumns fail before reading input
all zero limits remain valid for an empty document
a positive expectedColumns cannot exceed maxFieldsPerRecord
limits count input UTF-8 bytes, records, fields per record, and decoded field bytes
extra fixed columns fail before scanning the first extra field; missing columns fail before committing the final field
quote doubling is decoded by the same bounded field parser
every failed next call preserves its cursor and the complete caller output buffer
short output reports the exact decoded byte count and supports retry with another caller buffer
successful next changes only the decoded output prefix; owner, length, capacity, and tail remain unchanged
transactionality is per field; already returned fields of a later-invalid record are not rolled back
reader identity, cursor, and parser state are private
no implicit file/network effect, row materialization, output resize, or payload allocation
acceptance: focused managed execution, ownership/effect diagnostics, source-cost audit, selfhost differential, and required target closure remain separate gates
